groups.name: Pixel & lo-fi
groups.blurb: Low resolution, limited palettes, rooms as little worlds. Close to the first prototype.

groups.name: Flat shape & poster
groups.blurb: Big flat colour shapes, layered depth and silhouettes. Close to the Paper prototype.

groups.name: Painterly & hand-made
groups.blurb: Brushwork, watercolour and painted 3D. Softer, warmer, more texture.

groups.name: Dioramas & toy worlds
groups.blurb: A whole scene as a small object floating in space: something you could build layer by layer.

groups.name: Paintings & woodblock prints
groups.blurb: Where most of this comes from: lamplight, wet streets, quiet rooms.

groups.name: Photography
groups.blurb: The real thing: wet glass, blurred lights, glowing shop fronts.
